verdict: M167 is a real standalone three-mode arithmetic reuse kernel: source and postcompile evidence contain one 96-operation signed-INT8 main pool plus a separately costed 32-square sidecar, and two VCS seeds pass complete mode scoreboards, stalls, same-cycle replacement and fail-closed fault preservation. BACK now carries the ATLIF nonzero amplitude and locally repairs M166's lost-amplitude P0. The 29489.291809-um2 DC result is valid only for this stateless/output-registered kernel. Its 64.830306% difference from M165+M166 is not a matched resource-sharing saving because M167 externalizes both modules' accumulators, FIFOs, coefficient storage, requantization, barrier and controller. The 1.7x number remains a projection-capacity boundary. Proceed to an fc2 binary-event source-major/K-bank accumulate module while independently closing alpha-times-L range/rebalance, rsqrt formats and PAFT/valid825.

shared_pool_reality.qualification: The single source/mapped main pool is real. 'Mutually exclusive' is currently the one-hot meaning of a 2-bit issue_mode, not an implemented current-batch BN epoch protocol. The TB deliberately alternates FRONT/BACK/PREFOLD by index modulo three and therefore does not prove FRONT-all-tiles -> moment barrier -> PREFOLD -> BACK-replay ordering.

scoreboard_coverage: all 16 FRONT sum and sumsq deltas
accepted pending result across a younger illegal-mode attack
limitations: synthetic numeric inputs are mostly bounded to [-64,64] and positive small thresholds
no checkpoint alpha/offset/factors/scales or Q24 rail campaign
no five-issue projection accumulation or FRONT-to-BACK requantization
no barrier, rank/coefficient epoch or address sequence
the production active mask is issue_valid-qualified rather than accepted-work-qualified

atlif_amplitude.rtl_behavior: Every accepted BACK result carries event_bits plus event_amplitude=the accepted signed-Q24 back_threshold.
atlif_amplitude.software_behavior: OfficialATLIFSurrogate emits active*threshold, i.e. {0,+threshold} in binary mode.
remaining_proofs: materialize bit?threshold:0 at fc2 with a frozen activation binary point, or
fold threshold and activation scale into fc2 input-column weights with exact accumulator/RNE/saturation/BN2/residual order, or
accumulate selected raw fc2 weights from event bits and postpone the common positive threshold scale into the following current-batch BN2, proving the epsilon-adjusted normalization order

logic_only_dc.qualification: This is a wide-port, output-registered arithmetic kernel with no macro, controller or state SRAM. It is not physical PPA, extracted timing, Fmax, power or energy.

why_not_a_pool_saving: M165 projection accumulators, moments/count, factor state, two raw banks, requant/output FIFO and controller are absent
M166 7704-bit coefficient config, input/output FIFOs and five-beat controller are absent
M167 has no rank/coefficient epoch SRAM, barrier, rsqrt, coefficient reductions, fc2, BN2 or residual commit
the 81.36% sequential disappearance alone proves most of the delta is externalized state rather than a controlled removal of one 96-product pool
area_boundary.permitted_statement: The standalone multiplexed arithmetic kernel maps to 29489.291809 um2. A deliberately non-equivalent M165+M166 standalone sum is 83848.588969 um2; the 64.830306% numerical boundary is not a measured sharing saving or full-FFN area reduction.

capacity_boundary.qualification: 17 is only ceil(1600/96), and 10 is two five-issue rank3 passes. The dense number is a lower bound and the rank3 number omits rsqrt, coefficient reductions, RNE/saturation, barrier, state traffic, fc2, BN2 and drains.

findings.title: FRONT and BACK are not yet an executable numeric pipeline
findings.evidence: FRONT returns only two-row projection deltas. M165's five-beat projection accumulation, moment state, raw ownership, requantization and rank-state replay are absent, while BACK accepts already-formed Q8 rank_data.
findings.required_fix: Freeze the five-issue accumulation and Q8 RNE/saturation contract, then connect an address-bearing rank-state buffer or a cycle-model-equivalent bridge before calling M167 an operator.

findings.title: PREFOLD is a generic product port, not a coefficient generator
findings.evidence: PREFOLD emits 96 raw signed16 products. BACK consumes signed8 folded_left and signed24 folded_bias, but M167 has no alpha/offset/rsqrt, LR1 reduction, bias-center addition, RNE, saturation or coefficient storage.
findings.required_fix: Measure checkpoint/data-bound alpha ranges, use rank-wise factor rebalance, choose the alpha*L and offset*LR1 formats, and implement or cycle-model the reductions and requantization. Widen/resynthesize if signed8 cannot be proved.

findings.title: ATLIF amplitude is transported but fc2 equivalence is still open
findings.evidence: M167 correctly returns back_threshold with every BACK bitmap, but neither reconstruction nor fc2 weight/scale folding exists. There is no proof of accumulator width, RNE, saturation, BN2 or residual order.
findings.required_fix: Build a hardware-order fc2 miter for direct amplitude multiply, pre-folded columns, and postponed common-scale alternatives; admit only the bit-exact or valid825-approved choice.

findings.title: Rank3 and Q8 have no PAFT/valid825 admission
findings.evidence: The frozen ep35 FFN sn2 matrices are dense; M167 uses synthetic factors and records paft_valid825=false.
findings.required_fix: Bind the M29 rank3 factor checkpoint plus all Q8 scales/thresholds, run hardware-order valid825, and freeze the exact payload manifest.

findings.title: No fair full-FFN/operator cycle result exists
findings.evidence: The current 1.7x omits barrier/state traffic, coefficient generation, fc2, dynamic BN2 and residual commit; the dense 17-cycle term is a capacity lower bound rather than a measured matched baseline.
findings.required_fix: Use a cycle simulator for the selected standalone modules and identical SRAM/port assumptions on dense and rank3 paths, including the binary-event fc2 stage.

findings.title: Barrier-phase exclusivity is assumed, not enforced
findings.evidence: The module accepts any legal mode sequence and the TB alternates modes round-robin. There are no rank/coefficient epoch tags or illegal phase transitions.
findings.required_fix: A small local epoch wrapper or cycle-simulator contract must enforce FRONT completion, moment commit, PREFOLD completion and BACK replay identity. A system scheduler is not required.

findings.title: The 64.830306% area delta is non-matched and dominated by omitted state
findings.evidence: M167 has 2828 DFFs versus 15172 in M165+M166 and excludes both modules' FIFOs/config/accumulators/controllers. The netlists are not functionally equivalent.
findings.required_fix: If an area-saving claim is needed, synthesize a matched kernel-only duplicate-pool reference with identical ports/registers, changing only one versus two main product pools.

findings.title: The 1.7x capacity number is not measured speedup
findings.evidence: It is 17/10 from ceiling product counts. Adding only seven amortized prefold issues at the smallest 300-position group already changes the boundary to 1.696043x before every other cost.
findings.required_fix: Keep 1.7x in an analytical upper-bound row and report measured module/operator cycles separately.

findings.title: No coefficient/rank SRAM macro or port schedule exists
findings.evidence: M167 exposes 6782 ports and externalizes all long-lived state. DC reports zero macros.
findings.required_fix: The next module may stay local, but its cycle simulator must choose explicit rank/coefficient/weight/accumulator bank ports and charge load-to-use latency.

findings.title: Commercial synthesis is pre-macro and not physical PPA
findings.evidence: The 3 ns DC run uses an ideal clock, ZeroWireload and zero macros, with no CTS, extracted parasitics or SAIF/PTPX.
findings.required_fix: Retain logic-only wording and run macro-aware STA/power only on the selected final standalone block.

findings.title: Mapped RTL-to-gate equivalence is not closed
findings.evidence: Exact-SHA VCS and DC are sealed, but no M167 Formality receipt exists.
findings.required_fix: Run Formality after the architecture/numeric interface stabilizes.

findings.title: VCS does not exercise numeric rails or real phase payloads
findings.evidence: Two seeds pass, but the TB generates mostly [-64,64] operands, small positive thresholds and synthetic coefficients. No Q24 extrema, overflow witnesses or checkpoint vectors are used.
findings.required_fix: After formats freeze, add INT8/Q24 rail vectors and a checkpoint-derived hardware-order miter.

findings.title: Activity masks count offered rather than accepted work
findings.evidence: main_product_active_mask and square_product_active_mask depend on issue_valid/mode even when a pending result backpressures issue_accept.
findings.required_fix: Use separate offered-active and accepted-product ledgers; qualify paper work counts with issue_accept.

findings.title: Mode-exclusive result payloads are stored in disjoint register banks
findings.evidence: All 816 projection, 400 moment, 56 event and 1536 prefold result bits exist simultaneously even though only one mode is valid; all 2828 mapped DFFs are output/control state.
findings.required_fix: If area matters after P0 closure, pack mode payloads into a shared tagged result lane or stream PREFOLD products instead of carrying a 1536-bit elastic result.

findings.title: Protocol assertions do not directly prove illegal-request noncommit
findings.evidence: Ready logic prevents mode3 acceptance and the directed test observes fail-close, but there is no explicit SVA for illegal_request |-> !issue_accept and stable pending payload.
findings.required_fix: Add direct illegal-noncommit and mode-specific irrelevant-output assertions in the next identity.

allowed_claims: M167 maps FRONT, BACK and generic PREFOLD operands onto one source/mapped 96-operation signed-INT8 main pool, with a separate 32-square FRONT sidecar.
Sealed seed1 and an independent seed9173 VCS run each pass 361 issues/results, six SVA covers, 358 same-cycle replacements, output stalls and one fail-closed protocol attack.
M167 carries BACK event amplitude=threshold alongside 32 decision bits, locally fixing M166's unscaled-bit interface loss.
The standalone flattened logic-only kernel maps to 29489.291809 um2, 34692 cells and 2828 DFFs with setup +0.4987 ns and hold +0.0221 ns at a requested 3 ns ideal-clock ZeroWireload point.
The analytical dense/rank3 temporal product ratio is 1.666667x and the ideal 96-slot projection-capacity boundary is 17 versus 10 cycles.
forbidden_claims: M167 implements or verifies the current-batch BN barrier schedule
the event bitmap is already bit-exact through fc2/BN2/residual
64.830306% is a matched multiplier-sharing or full-FFN area saving
1.7x is measured operator, FFN, network or system speedup
all alpha*L coefficients fit signed INT8
PAFT/valid825, Formality, macro-aware PPA or power is complete
next_priority: M168 hardware: build a standalone binary-event fc2 source-major accumulator. Consume M167's 16-lane bitmap, select frozen fc2 input-column weights without event multipliers, and evaluate K=1/2/4 banked multi-source accumulation under explicit weight/accumulator SRAM ports.

M168 numeric: compare direct {0,threshold}, threshold-folded fc2 columns, and raw-weight accumulation with threshold postponed into current-batch BN2. Freeze accumulator width, scale, epsilon, RNE, saturation and residual order before choosing the trick.
In parallel with M168: derive per-module dynamic alpha ranges and use rank-wise dyadic L/R rebalance to maximize signed8 alpha*L coverage; widen or lane-serialize any failures and resynthesize.
Then implement/model moment-to-rsqrt/alpha/offset. Because it is paid once per hidden group, prioritize correctness and small LUT/Newton hardware over advertising it as the main speedup.
Bind M29 rank3 factors and M87/M162 deployment results, then run PAFT/valid825 hardware-order validation and an identical-port dense-versus-rank3+event-fc2 cycle simulation.
Only after the selected standalone modules stabilize: matched duplicate-versus-shared kernel DC, Formality, and macro-aware STA/SAIF/PTPX.
